page.overview:
Who is Black Pit Bob-Omb?

The Black Pit Bob-Omb is a large Bob-omb capable of creating explosions. It only appears in the The Super Mario Bros. Super Show! episode "Rolling Down the River."

In Rolling Down the River, King Koopa ordered Mouser to bring him a Black Pit Bob-Omb. King Koopa lit the Bob-omb's fuse and threw it into the river near Ding Bell. The Black Pit Bob-Omb's explosion created a black pit.
